1037.description: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1101.description: A single-leg squat holding the handles for balance. It builds leg strength.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

1165.description: A strict overhead press where you clean or lift the bar to your shoulders without a rack.
instructions: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

1229.description: A straight-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. It isolates the lats with almost no help from the arms.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.

1293.description: Press two dumbbells up while your upper back rests on a stability ball. A good way to train the chest with extra core and balance demand.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and dumbbells in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling the exercise ball until your lower back is supported on the ball and your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动双脚，滚动健身球，直到下背部受到球的支撑并且膝盖呈 90 度角。
将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1357.description: Hanging from a bar with just one hand. It builds grip strength and gives the shoulder a stretch.
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with one hand.
Lift your feet and hang with your arm straight.
Keep your shoulder active and your body still.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Lower yourself carefully and switch hands.

1421.description: A modified push-up variation where you shift your weight toward your wrists. It strengthens the forearms, chest and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body down towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, lower your forearms to the ground, keeping your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to lift your forearms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦肘部成 90 度角，将前臂放低至地面，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推动前臂，使其回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1485.description: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

1549.description: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.

1677.description: A dumbbell biceps curl performed seated. It keeps your legs out of the movement.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1741.description: Both arms extend dumbbells backward at once from a hinged position. A simple way to load the triceps from the back of the arm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1805.description: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1869.description: Seated machine move that pushes the legs outward to train the outer hips.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Hold the handles for stability.
Push your legs apart smoothly.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.

1933.description: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2125.description: A lying side stretch that gently lengthens one side of the body.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2189.description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands with an overhand grip, and raise it above your head.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Extend your arms and raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，正握，将其举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
伸展双臂，将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2317.description: A seated lateral raise with bent elbows. Targets the side delts with a shorter lever.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your elbows bent, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持肘部弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2381.description: A one-arm overhead press that builds the shoulders and challenges your core.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Stand or sit tall and brace your core.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

2509.description: A chest-supported row with an underhand grip that works the lats and upper back.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

2765.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns down. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2957.description: A split squat holding dumbbells at your sides with the front foot raised. It deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3021.description: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower, squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你下降时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将胸部向前推。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3149.description: Drawing your chin straight back to line up your head over your shoulders. It's a simple neck posture exercise.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3213.description: A standing side bend where each hand slides down toward the same-side foot in turn. It mobilises the trunk and trains the obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向右弯曲，将右手伸向右脚，同时保持左手向一侧延伸。
返回起始位置，然后腰部向左弯曲，将左手伸向左脚，同时保持右手向侧面延伸。
重复左右弯曲动作达到所需的重复次数。

3341.description: A dumbbell lunge variation for leg strength and balance, working quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

3405.description: Pull your elbows back into a W shape to strengthen the mid-back and rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

3469.description: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

3533.description: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3661.description: Hold an upright seated posture with no pad.
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

3725.description: A lunge performed with a barbell held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands shoulder and core stability.
instructions: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.

3789.description: A single-leg hip hinge with a one-arm band row. It challenges your balance and trains hamstrings, glutes and back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3853.description: A standing leg lift to the side against band tension. It trains your outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it to one foot.
Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side, keeping your toes forward.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3917.description: A floor press with a reverse grip, which shifts more work to the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Lie on the floor with a barbell above your chest, hands in an underhand grip.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up.
Keep your wrists straight.

3981.description: A push up supported on your fingertips. It challenges the hands and forearms as well as the chest.
instructions: Get into a high plank on your fingertips.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up.
Reduce the range if your fingers tire.

4045.description: Side lunge holding a kettlebell at the chest. It trains the thighs, glutes and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands and stand tall.
Take a big step to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

4109.description: A split squat with a band pulling you outward, adding inner thigh work.
instructions: Anchor the band to the side and loop it around the working leg.
Step into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press back up while resisting the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

4173.description: A Romanian deadlift with a band adding resistance as you stand. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand on the band with it attached to the barbell and hold the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees.
Lower the bar along your legs to mid shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your back flat throughout.

4237.description: A seated overhead press with the dumbbells held close together, palms facing in. It works the front delts and triceps.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Hold them close together with palms facing each other.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and ribs down.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
Do not arch your lower back.

4365.description: A resting yoga pose that gently stretches the back and hips, similar to child pose.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
Release slowly.

4429.description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

4493.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the side of the back (latissimus dorsi). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your side of the back (latissimus dorsi) while lying on your side with your arm overhead.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4557.description: A deep kneeling stretch with the back foot raised, aimed at the thighs and hip flexors.
instructions: Kneel facing away from a wall or couch with one shin up against it.
Place your other foot flat on the floor in front in a lunge.
Squeeze your glute and tuck your pelvis under.
Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch in the front of your rear thigh.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Switch legs.

4621.description: A sit-up that finishes with an overhead press, joining core and shoulder work in a single rep.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Sit up using your abs.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.

4685.description: A side bend with a band for oblique resistance. It strengthens the sides of the waist.
instructions: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end at your side.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist away from the band.
Squeeze your obliques and return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4749.description: A Romanian deadlift combined with a bent-over row. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and back in one rep.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back, until the dumbbells are below your knees.
Keep your back flat and row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

5005.description: Seated row using a band and an underhand grip. This grip adds extra work for the lats and biceps.
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and the band looped around your feet.
Hold the band ends with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

5069.description: Lunge forward while holding a kettlebell at your chest and rotate over the front leg. Trains legs and trunk rotation together.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell at chest height with both hands.
Step forward into a lunge, front knee over your ankle.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg, keeping hips square.
Turn back to center and push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

5133.description: Lifting your arms behind your back while seated. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest lifted.

5261.description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and upper chest.
instructions: Set a bench to about 60 to 75 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your back against the pad.

5389.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes and hip. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Place the roller under the glutes and hip and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean toward the crossed leg and roll gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5517.description: A bodyweight row hanging under a bar with an underhand grip. Builds the back and biceps.
instructions: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

5581.description: Kneeling one-arm lat pulldown for a stretch and strong contraction on each side.
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly and switch sides.

5837.description: A hip hinge where you pull a band through your legs. Teaches the hinge and strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.

5901.description: A standing forward bend with a twist. Stretches the back of the legs and rotates the spine.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Come up and switch sides.

5965.description: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.

6221.description: A standing overhead extension with a dumbbell held in both hands. It targets the triceps.
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core braced.
Avoid arching your back.

6541.description: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

6733.description: A good morning done on a hack squat machine. The machine supports your back while you hinge at the hips.
instructions: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.

6797.description: A sideways step up onto a bench with a barbell on the back. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

7565.description: Pullover with slightly bent arms using a barbell for lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.

7693.description: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

8141.description: A standing cable fly where your hands cross in front of the chest. It focuses on squeezing the pecs.
instructions: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.

8653.description: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

9485.description: A Romanian deadlift flowing straight into a squat while holding a kettlebell. It trains the hips and thighs with a nice rhythm.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.

9677.description: From a plank, you hop your feet side to side. It challenges the core and gets your heart rate up.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.

9869.description: A one-arm cable reverse fly with a palm-up grip, hinged at 45 degrees.
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle with your palm up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

9933.description: A seated lateral raise lifting one dumbbell at a time. Sitting reduces body swing so the side delts do the work.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.

10189.description: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.

11277.description: A front raise using a low cable. It builds the front of the shoulders with steady tension.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

11789.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

0013.description: A lying leg raise with the legs lifted straight up and lowered with control. Works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the ground.
Lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Simultaneously, throw your legs down towards the ground, keeping them straight.
Raise your legs back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
抬起双腿，直到它们垂直于地面。
将双腿放低回到起始位置。
同时，将双腿向地面放下，保持伸直。
将双腿抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0077.description: A reverse lunge with the bar on your back, stepping back and returning to standing. Works the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Take a step backward with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Bend both knees to lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到左大腿与地面平行。
推动左脚跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

0205.description: A pulldown to the chest from a high pulley, with a slight lean back. It trains the lats and the upper back.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulley is at the highest position.
Sit facing the machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable attachment with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Pull the cable attachment down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the cable back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整拉索机，使滑轮处于最高位置。
面向机器坐着，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆附件，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将电缆附件向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳索回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0269.description: A crunch with your calves resting on a stability ball. The raised legs fix the hips and focus the work on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a stability ball and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed and the ball steady.

0333.description: A dumbbell kickback done in a hinged position. You extend the arms back to isolate the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your upper arms close to your sides, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将上臂靠近身体两侧，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0397.description: Seated with forearms on your thighs and palms facing in, you move the dumbbells with your wrists. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing the dumbbells to hang down.
Keeping your wrists in a neutral position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将前臂放在大腿上，让哑铃垂下。
保持手腕处于中立位置，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0461.description: A wide squat that finishes with a jump, landing back in a deep position like a frog. It builds leg power and endurance.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and your toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat with your hands between your knees.
Explode up into a jump.
Land softly back in the deep squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees out.
Rest briefly between sets.

0525.description: You clean a kettlebell upside down from a hang to the rack. It builds grip, shoulders and forearm control.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Allow the kettlebell to hang down between your legs, with your arm fully extended.
In one fluid motion, explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the kettlebell up towards your shoulder.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your wrist so that the bottom of the kettlebell is facing up.
Catch the kettlebell at shoulder height with your elbow bent and your palm facing up.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，正手握住。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
让壶铃垂在双腿之间，手臂完全伸展。
以一种流畅的动作，爆发性地伸展你的臀部和膝盖，同时将壶铃拉向你的肩膀。
当壶铃到达肩膀高度时，旋转手腕，使壶铃底部朝上。
在与肩同高的位置抓住壶铃，肘部弯曲，手掌朝上。
通过反向运动将壶铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0589.description: A one arm row on a lever machine, pulling the handle toward your hip. Works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Let the barbell hang in front of you with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，正手握住杠铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部抬起。
让杠铃悬挂在你面前，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0653.description: A push-up with your hands on a bosu ball. The unstable surface trains the chest, arms and core stabilizers.
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side facing up.
Position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将博苏球平放在地上，平面朝上。
将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在博苏球的外边缘。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体向博苏球方向降低。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0717.description: Lying on your side, you push your body away from the floor with one arm. Works the chest, shoulder and triceps.
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom hand on the ground directly under your shoulder, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your bottom hand to lift your body off the ground, keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Extend your top arm straight up towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将下面的手放在肩膀正下方的地面上，手指指向前方。
用下面的手将身体抬离地面，保持双腿伸直，核心肌群参与。
将上臂伸向天花板，形成从头部到脚后跟的直线。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0781.description: A staggered-stance squat where the back leg stays put. It works the quads and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and the other back.
Keep your torso upright and core tight.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

0845.description: A weighted Russian twist with the feet lifted, rotating the torso side to side. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet lifted off the ground, keeping your legs together.
Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the ground on your right side.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the ground on your left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚离开地面，保持双腿并拢。
用双手将重物放在胸前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
稍微向后倾斜以锻炼核心肌肉。
将躯干向右扭转，将重量移向右侧地面。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将重量转移到左侧地面。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0909.description: Lunges with band resistance. They build the quads and glutes with extra tension.
instructions: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.

0973.description: Rise onto your toes against band resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.
